mechanism: Both are monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) with additive inhibition of MAO, leading to severe accumulation of monoamines (serotonin, norepinephrine, dopamine) and risk of hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome.
action: Absolute contraindication; do not combine these agents; maintain appropriate washout period (14 days minimum) between discontinuation of one MAOI and initiation of another.
